files.html:
Dochi Real Armor 0.1.1

Changed

  • Renamed the project from CNPC Real Armor to Dochi Real Armor.
  • Changed the mod ID and command root from cnpc_real_armor to dochi_real_armor.
  • Updated the jar name, resource namespace, mixin configuration, and common config name.
  • Reworked the config UI with DRM-style sections, non-overlapping labels, centered text, and ON/OFF switches.

Added

  • Easy NPC support with an independent enable switch.
  • Shared vanilla-style armor, toughness, Protection enchantment, knockback-resistance, and durability handling for CustomNPCs and Easy NPC.
  • Optional head, chest, and legs hit-region armor; legs use leggings and boots.
  • Dochi RPG Maker Mods Config integration and a matching standalone config screen.
  • English, Korean, Russian, Japanese, and Simplified Chinese UI translations.
  • Permission-checked server config synchronization.

Fixed

  • Armor is now calculated whether debug messages are ON or OFF.

Commands

  • /dochi_real_armor status
  • /dochi_real_armor split true|false
  • /dochi_real_armor durability true|false
  • /dochi_real_armor debug true|false
